meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以配置 NanoClaw 使用 OpenCode 作为代理提供商，从而调用 OpenRouter、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek 等模型，而不是 Anthropic Agent SDK。
howto.when: 当用户通过 `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` 命令为某个代理组设置提供商为 OpenCode，并重启该组后触发。

say.text: 帮我为组 my-group 设置 OpenCode 提供商。
配置 DeepSeek 作为 OpenCode 模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can configure NanoClaw to use OpenCode as an agent provider, enabling models from OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc., instead of the Anthropic Agent SDK.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user sets the provider to opencode for an agent group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` and restarts the group.

say_en.text: Set up OpenCode provider for group my-group.
say_en.note: Runs `ncl groups config update --id my-group --provider opencode` and restarts.

say_en.text: Configure DeepSeek as the OpenCode model.
say_en.note: Sets env vars like OPENCODE_PROVIDER=deepseek, etc.
